Name: Ilucie's Legendary Fish Family II
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
[center][/center][left][/left]Adds five new legendary fish

- Baby Angler
- Lady Glacierfish
- Daughter of Crimsonfish
- Shiny Carp
- Legend III

They can now be placed in ponds, each featuring unique colors. They also drop roe.


To catch these fish you have to start the Quest "Qi's Extended Family II" from the Questboard in Qi's Walnut Room.
You can catch them while the quest is active.


Have fun :)


The mod has i18n support, with English as the default language.
German is also available.
